title: MVC Jaylen Follower Pack - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 4 NPCs from MVC Jaylen Follower Pack.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by MVC Jaylen Follower Pack (MVC Jaylen Follower Pack.esp).

Install this if MVC Jaylen Follower Pack.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
